sections.content:
<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
def cart(fr):
    d={}
    for n in fr.segmentation['nodes']:
        if n['color'] in ('O','B'):
            b=n['boundary']; rows=[p[0] for p in b]; cols=[p[1] for p in b]
            d[n['color']]=(min(rows),min(cols))
    return d
print('start', cart(current_frame))
for i in range(3):
    action(['UP'], intent='explore')
    r=last_action_result
    if r.get('no_impact') or r.get('done') or r.get('level_completed'): 
        print('stopped', r.get('no_impact'), r.get('level_completed')); break
    print('after UP', i+1, cart(current_frame), 'player', [ (n['color'],n['boundary'][0]) for n in current_frame.segmentation['nodes'] if n['color']=='N'])
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>

<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
def cart(fr):
    d={}
    for n in fr.segmentation['nodes']:
        if n['color'] in ('O','B'):
            b=n['boundary']; rows=[p[0] for p in b]; cols=[p[1] for p in b]
            d[n['color']]=(min(rows),min(cols))
    return d
print('start', cart(current_frame))
for i in range(3):
    action(['UP'], intent='explore')
    r=last_action_result
    if r.get('no_impact') or r.get('done') or r.get('level_completed'): 
        print('stopped', r.get('no_impact'), r.get('level_completed')); break
    print('after UP', i+1, cart(current_frame), 'player', [ (n['color'],n['boundary'][0]) for n in current_frame.segmentation['nodes'] if n['color']=='N'])
</parameter>
</function>
